name: Chiku v0.1.7 - Satellite Reminder Fix, Universal Linux AppImage & Debian Package
notes:
• Fixed satellite reminder card layout (prevent squished text and clipping)
• Universal Linux AppImage support for all Linux distributions
• Debian & Kali Linux native .deb package
• Platform-aware updater (Windows gets .exe, Linux gets .AppImage/.deb)
• Smooth transitions and meeting notifications
